Novice Garmor is part of  Gekh Coal's search crew in the Underdark during Act One.
“
Gekh does the talking around here - bother him.
„
— Garmor

Involvement

Act One

Garmor guards the boats in the Decrepit Village. He is a duergar of few words, and directs the party to seek out Gekh instead.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Enlarge ()

Grow in size to become stronger

You gain  Advantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Strength, and weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 damage.

 Range: Self
 Recharge: Long rest
 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Greataxe
Damage: 4~15
1d12 + 3⁠Slashing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Rage: Bear Heart ( + )

Enter a  Rage that makes you tough enough to stand up to any punishment.

You can use  Unrelenting Ferocity, and have Resistance to all damage types except ⁠Psychic damage.

 Range: Self
 Reckless Attack ()   –  Greataxe
Damage: 4~15
1d12 + 3⁠Slashing
Throw all caution in the wind to gain  Advantage on your melee  Attack Roll.

Until your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls, but enemies also have advantage on attack rolls against you.

 Range: Normal weapon range
 Throw ()   –  Javelin
Damage: 4~9
1d6 + 3⁠Piercing

Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory.

Your Strength affects how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage.

The damage of weapons with the thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage.

 Range: 3-18 m (10-60 ft)
 Unrelenting Ferocity ()
Healing: 4~11
1d8 + 3⁠Healing

Muster up your stamina to heal yourself.

Can only be used once per Rage.

 Range: Self
